objective_breakdown: ED>=500.94 Wh/kg (stage2, contract calc-energy formula; thick electrodes raise ED toward active-layer asymptote while CC/separator fixed mass dilutes); 4C fast charge without plating (stage3, plated=false; 4C=20 A fixed vs nominal 5 Ah so overcapacity design lowers effective charge SOC and anode plating risk); T_max<=333.15 K judged on 4C_charge_45C (45C ambient leaves only 15 K headroom; lumped thermal: need heat reduction + aggressive cooling h). Key contract mechanics: area is ED-neutral but 1/area safety lever; CC thinning is pure ED win (in-plane resistance unmodeled); trade-off ED-vs-charge is weak in this formulation, binding pair is ED vs T_max.
candidate_strategy: Round 1: baseline Chen2020 characterization + A1 ThickCCslim (electrodes x2, CC 8/6um, sep 10um — ED probe) + A2 TransportCool (sigma 2.0 S/m, t+ 0.45, D 4.5e-10, particles x0.5, h 200, area x1.5 — safety probe) + CeilProbe (extreme architecture+formulation combo; opening ceiling assessment recorded, escalation disabled per ablation). Rounds 2+: refine measured-effective levers (thickness/area/transport/h/N-P), DFN for passers, safety co-check (4C lumped+plating) every round.
budget_allocation: ~8 rounds max, <=4 candidates/round each with 1C SPMe (+DFN for passers) + calc-energy + 4C SPMe/DFN; DFN reserved for passers/finalists; closing deliverables after achievement or three-strike negative result.
risk_and_fallback: ED unreachable in architecture space -> three-strike questioning -> honest negative result with 'if X relaxed' note (ceiling_escalation OFF forbids material path); T_max failure -> h up (immersion-class), area up, heat down via transport/particles; plating -> overcapacity + area + particles + transport; parameter-name errors fixed via 'unknown parameter name(s)' validation; DFN solver failure auto-degrades to SPMe (screening-level only).

llm_reason: Round 2 fallback diagnosis (architecture scale): ED lever stack is solved (546-589 vs 500.94) and T_max solved by h=200, but the 4C charge fails at START-OF-CHARGE: Chen2020 exchange-current densities are concentration-dependent, so at the discharged state (anode nearly delithiated, cathode fully lithiated) i0 -> 0 on BOTH electrodes and 20 A produces a giant activation polarization: anode surface potential collapses below 0 V (plating) and terminal voltage spikes to 4.2 V (trip). R2C showed current-density dilution x1.5 gets furthest (1.44 Ah, borderline -5.7 mV). Round 3 attacks the polarization at its root with zero-to-low ED cost: smaller particle radii (active area a_s=3eps/r up ~2x at 1.5 um, ~3x at 1.0 um; solid diffusion time r^2/D down 3.4-7.7x), N/P up (residual anode lithium at discharge end keeps i0 finite; more anode active area; ED cost ~6% at N/P 1.2), area x1.5 dilution. Particle radii 1.0-1.5 um are primary-particle-scale values (ultra-fast-charge formulation class, manufacturable; noted as aggressive).

reason: real_compute=false (session default): true DFT/MD endorsement (run-orca/run-cp2k/run-md) skipped per protocol; case is architecture-only (start_stage=3, no molecular candidates, no endorsement targets), and cell-level conclusions carry dual-model mechanical evidence instead (SPMe + DFN runs of the final design R4A, all criteria mechanically evaluated via log-evaluate).

recommendation: Final design R4A MarginAnode1p0 (Chen2020 NMC811|graphite baseline + architecture overrides: electrodes 95.3/107.5 um, width 2.37 m area x1.5, CC 6/4 um, separator 8 um, particles 1.5/1.0 um, electrolyte transport sigma 2.0 S/m t+ 0.45 D 4.5e-10 m2/s, h=200 W/m2/K). All three task criteria hold at BOTH model levels: (1) energy density 583.93 Wh/kg (DFN calc-energy; SPMe 583.46) >= 500.94 Wh/kg (+16.6% margin); (2) 4C fast charge (20 A protocol, 318.15 K ambient) accepts 8.12 Ah in 1461 s to the 4.2 V ceiling (84.3% SOC) with anode surface potential min +0.0212 V (DFN; SPMe +0.0270 V) -> no lithium plating; (3) T_max 320.36 K (47.2 C) <= 333.15 K (60 C). 1C discharge: 9.6251 Ah clean at 2.5000 V (no 7200-s truncation). Design path: round 1 characterized baseline (ED 400.75 fail, 4C plated -0.4385 V) and bounded the architecture+formulation ED ceiling (CeilProbe ~620-630 Wh/kg estimate, truncated); round 2 localized the failure to empty-anode start-of-charge activation polarization (all four plated, R2C borderline -5.7 mV); round 3 fixed it with current-density dilution + 1.5 um particles (R3C first full pass, +0.0162 V) and identified the N/P>1 branch as structurally dead vs the fixed 2.5 V cut-off; round 4 polished ED via thin CC/separator and widened the anode margin via 1.0 um anode particles -> R4A selected (dominates R4B on all axes; R4B kept as validated fallback with +0.0144 V margin). Caveats for the paper: single-layer stack model (multilayer productization outside simulation boundary); 6/4 um foils and 1.0 um anode particles are aggressive manufacturing values (fallbacks exist); electrolyte/additive/binder not in parameter set (BOM uses annotated literature defaults); no aging simulation (cycle life not simulated); true DFT/MD skipped (real_compute=false, recorded in endorse entry). No three-strike trigger: the plating cause fell in rounds 1-2 and was resolved by a direction change in round 3 (cause-level diagnosis written in round-2/3 evaluate notes).
